{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Silk blouse, relaxed fit with a subtle drape, midnight blue (#0A0F1C), smooth woven silk.
Wool-blend tailored trousers, straight leg cut, charcoal grey (#36454F), heavy worsted wool.
Structured blazer, single-breasted with notch lapels, deep emerald green (#046B48), fine herringbone weave.
Leather pumps, pointed toe with a modest block heel, burgundy red (#720E1E), calfskin leather.

This ensemble strikes the perfect balance for an autumn evening date at a casual restaurant by blending professional polish with romantic warmth. The structured blazer and tailored trousers establish a smart silhouette suitable for the 19:30 hour without appearing too rigid for a first meeting. Rich jewel tones like emerald and burgundy complement the artificial lighting while harmonizing with the cool grey of the autumn season. Finally, the soft silk blouse adds a touch of delicate femininity that ensures you feel both confident and approachable."}
